policy: One gen4 form per fresh agent context. Draw no pixels for two forms in the same context. Order is the 11 megas, then 107 normal forms. After one form finishes, stop so the next context starts clean and reads this file.
resume: Take the first item whose status is in_progress (resume its _work checkpoints) or, if none, the first pending. Skip needs_fix. Do not start the following item in the same context.
playback: pokemon_arena_revenge_claude plays monsterSprite/<species>/agent-sprite-forge/sheet.png after that form's data/dir8.js entry exists. pokemon_arena_2d battles still play pokeAnim and do not read this sheet.
later_non_mega: Normal forms are now in items after the 11 megas. legends-arceus, female, and shiny are not items. 0469_yanmega is a normal form, not a mega.

items.notes: Opaque 4325, bbox (0,1)-(95,94). Crest is the top-right (top 20% centroid x=61, y 1-19, x 37-82). Yellow eye sits just left of the crest (about x 58-63), so the beak points left. Confirm beak-tip x < eye x before locking the flip. If so, unflipped dirs are N NW W SW and flipped dirs are S SE E NE. E must face screen-right. Move wings, beak, tail, and the two short talons at the lower right (y about 79-87). Lower-left fragments are wingtips, not legs. No biped run.

Opaque 1879, bbox (16,14)-(79,81). Head and ears are on the right (top 22% centroid x=54.6). Arms reach left. Legs are separate around y 74-80 at x 32-41 and x 54-63. No wings. The mouth is small: a roar may only open the existing mouth a little. Do not invent a huge jaw. Spin uses the existing legs, arms, and ears only.

Opaque 2987, bbox (8,8)-(87,86). Snout is on the right. Yellow eye is left of the snout (x about 37-47), so the still faces right. Two legs at the bottom (x about 16-33 and 57-70). Move the jaw, both scythe arms, the legs, the tail, and the chest fins already drawn. No bird wings. Roar is the jaw opening. Feet stay on the ground. Own rig, not garchomp-mega-z.

Opaque 2825, bbox (1,6)-(95,90). Highest spike is on the right (y=6, x about 68-74). Facing is weak; measure it. Left and right are wings. The bottom tapers into one tail. No separate legs. Do not walk or land. Bank the existing wings and sway the tail. Do not copy the garchomp-mega rig.

Opaque 1582, bbox (24,15)-(71,80). Head is on the left (top 22% centroid x=42.5). Legs are separate around y 75-77 at x 26-36 and x 51-60. Arms stay close to the torso. No wings and no long tail. Roar is a short-snout howl. Keep both feet planted. Do not close the gap between the legs during the spin. Own rig, not lucario-mega-z.

Opaque 1513, bbox (17,14)-(79,82). Head is on the left (centroid x=38.6). A long arm reaches right. Shins split around y 66-74 (x 32-37 and x 44-52) but the feet merge by y 76. No wide stance. No wings. Flip the left-facing profile. Do not copy the lucario-mega rig.

Opaque 4009, bbox (7,11)-(88,84). Frontal. The highest pixels are the tree on the right shoulder, not a profile head. Torso and thighs are one fur mass. Only the feet split around y 74-82. Arms are the side branches. The back tree is not a limb. Roar uses the mouth and the arms. Do not split the fur skirt into a long stride. A full 360 roll shatters the tree; use a readable turn that still rotates the body, and keep the tree attached.

Opaque 2837, bbox (8,11)-(87,84). Head is on the left (centroid x=35.9). The red at x about 10-19 is the arm blade, not an eye. The shape to the right is a cape. Two legs: a left mass and x about 49-59. Move the left blade, the legs, and the cape. Do not draw a second large blade that is not in the still. A roar is a short shout; the blade and the spin carry the attack.

Opaque 2492, bbox (21,1)-(75,94). Almost frontal. Horns and dark eyes sit slightly right of center (eye centroid x=51.9). Sleeves around y 54-62 and a hem that joins into one shape. No separate legs. Splits in the hem are tassels, not feet. No wings and no large jaw. Do not invent legs or a big mouth. Turn and spin the sleeves, hair, and hem. A roar is a small open of the existing face plus rings, only if the face pixels support it.

Opaque 3434, bbox (0,17)-(95,78). No front-shiny.png; do not invent one. Head side is to the right (top 22% centroid x=54.6) with the back ridge. Red marks are lava on the shell, not eyes. Two leg masses under the belly around y 71-73 (x 0-35 and x 57-92). The cross on the shell is not a limb. Roar is the jaw. Keep the two-support tread. Do not rear up onto two legs. The body is long, so a full roll can shatter it; rotate only as far as the shell stays one piece, and still make the turn readable.

Opaque 1978, bbox (0,7)-(95,88). No front-shiny.png. The head flame is on the right (peak x about 58-64, top 22% centroid x=51.8). There is no red or yellow mouth. Move the head flame and the cloak tatters. Fragments at the bottom are cloth, not legs. No separate arms or wings. Do not add legs or a painted mouth. A roar is the flame flaring plus rings. Spin the flame and the cloak slowly enough that the body stays one piece.
